title: Body styling
heading: Dress for your proportions, coloring and preferences.
intro: Start with an empty wardrobe. Get three complete menswear outfits with reasons for the fit, fabrics and color combinations.
profileIntro: Use a soft tape without pulling it tight. Required measurements are marked *; units are cm and kg.
generatingNote: Analyzing your saved measurements and planning three complete outfits. You can stay on this page; your previous recommendations remain available.
aiOffTitle: 未接入 AI，先給你基礎建議
aiOff: 現在生成的是按固定穿搭規則組合的基礎建議，同樣遵守季節、場合和你的避開項。設定並啟用文字模型後，可以得到更有針對性的解釋。
statusError: Could not check the AI configuration. Try again.
schematicNote: Local schematics show colors, silhouette and stylized texture. They do not simulate try-on, actual fabric feel or brand sizing.
historyEmpty: Your first recommendation will appear here. No clothing uploads are needed.
snapshot: This report uses the measurements saved when it was generated.
emptyIntro: Fill in your height, chest, waist and hips, choose what you want to emphasize, then generate your first three looks.
formInvalid: Please complete the four required measurements with positive numbers.
inseamInvalid: Inseam must be shorter than height.
goalRequired: Choose at least one styling goal.

error.ai_unavailable: The text AI service is not enabled or configured yet. Save your measurements first, then check again after setup.
error.invalid_measurements: Complete valid height, chest, waist and hips measurements first. Inseam must be shorter than height.
error.invalid_ai_response: The model could not produce three complete, consistent looks. Your measurements are saved; please try again.
error.ai_timeout: The model took too long. Your measurements are saved; please try again.
error.ai_failed: The model service could not complete the request. Check its connection or try again.
error.load: Could not load this recommendation. It may not exist or belong to this account.
error.history: Could not load your recommendation history.
error.save: Could not save measurements. Please try again.
error.generic: Could not complete this request. Please try again.
error.body_measurements_conflict: Your measurements or styling preferences changed elsewhere. Load the latest data before saving or generating; the saved data has not been overwritten.
error.queue_failed: 後台任務服務暫時不可用，請稍後重試。
error.job_lost: 生成任務中斷了，請重試。

personal.title: Personal color, fabrics and fit
personal.intro: All optional. Leave uncertain details blank; only your self-reported information is used.
personal.skinHelp: Look in natural daylight without makeup. Unsure of undertone? Wrist veins that look blue-purple suggest cool, green suggests warm; silver flattering you suggests cool, gold suggests warm.
personal.colorHelp: Preferred colors guide choices. Avoided colors are excluded from outfits. Selecting a family moves it out of the opposite group.
personal.fabricHelp: Use your past wearing experience. Avoided fibers and common blends containing them are excluded; check actual labels and try garments on.

feedback.title: Was this outfit useful?
feedback.intro: Feedback informs future generations without changing this report. Click again to clear.
feedback.error: Could not save feedback. Please try again.

measurementHelp: Enter body measurements, not flat garment dimensions. Measure body inseam from crotch to floor. Stand naturally with the tape snug, not tight; use the same waist position each time. Shoulder width and thigh are optional.
legacyReport: This report predates the color and fabric upgrade. Add preferences and generate again for the new analysis; this record stays unchanged.
generateRules: 快速基礎建議（不用 AI）
personalSection: 個人配色、面料與穿衣困擾
pendingTitle: 正在後台生成你的三套搭配
pendingNote: 通常需要一到兩分鐘。可以離開這個頁面，完成後會在導覽上提示，已設定通知管道的話也會通知你。
failedTitle: 這份報告沒有生成成功

today.title: 今日穿搭
today.basis: 按{season}的穿搭規則和你的身材資料生成，不呼叫 AI。
today.basisNoBody: 按{season}的穿搭規則生成；填寫身材資料後會更貼合你。
today.explain: 讓 AI 講講為什麼
today.explainFailed: AI 暫時沒能解釋這套，請稍後再試。
today.useWardrobe: 用我衣櫥裡的衣服搭一套
today.addClothes: 上傳幾件常穿的衣服，以後就能用你自己的衣服搭
today.error: 今日穿搭暫時載入失敗。

wardrobe.title: 和你的衣櫥對比
wardrobe.empty: 衣櫥還是空的，錄入衣服後可以看到哪些已經有了。
wardrobe.complete: 這幾套需要的單品你的衣櫥裡都有。
wardrobe.suggestTitle: 優先補這幾件（現有衣物能搭出 {combinations} 套）
wardrobe.gain: 能和現有衣物多搭出 {count} 套
wardrobe.noGain: 先補齊上衣、褲子和鞋，才能算出能多搭幾套

packing.title: 出差打包清單
packing.intro: 按目的地天氣、每天的場合和你的身材規則，算出最少需要帶的幾件衣服，以及每天怎麼穿。
packing.cityPlaceholder: 留空則使用你儲存的位置
packing.occasionsHelp: 多選時按天輪流安排，例如「通勤、正式」就是一天通勤一天正式。
packing.error: 打包清單生成失敗，請檢查日期後重試。
packing.unknownCity: 沒有找到這個城市，換個寫法試試。
packing.forecast: 按 {location} 的天氣預報安排。
packing.noForecast: 超出預報範圍或未提供地點，按日曆季節安排。
packing.ownedOtherColor: 可用衣櫥裡的 {name}（顏色不同）

styleExplore.title: 風格探索
styleExplore.subtitle: 日系男裝有很多分支，憑直覺選，找到適合你的那一支。
styleExplore.entryHint: 還不知道自己的風格？做個測試
styleExplore.intro: 接下來會給你看一組日系搭配。不用想太多，憑第一感覺選「喜歡」「一般」或「不喜歡」就好。
styleExplore.howRoundOne: 第一輪：每個日系分支各一套，共 11 套左右。
styleExplore.howRoundTwo: 第二輪：在你最喜歡的三個方向裡再各看兩套。
styleExplore.howResult: 最後告訴你的主風格、入門單品清單（會對照你的衣櫥）和可以拿去搜的關鍵字。
styleExplore.roundOne: 第一輪 · 憑第一感覺
styleExplore.roundTwo: 第二輪 · 細看你喜歡的方向
styleExplore.unsure: 這次沒有特別心動的，新手可以先從這兩種最穩的風格開始
styleExplore.likedColors: 你選中的搭配裡常出現：{colors}

bodyNote.solid: 參考：日本的穿搭指南認為，工裝、山系、Cityboy、阿美咔嘰這類寬鬆廓形對身材更友善。喜歡才是第一位。
bodyNote.tall_slim: 參考：高瘦身形穿 きれいめ、暗黑 Mode、常春藤這類俐落或長版的風格很有優勢。喜歡才是第一位。

styleExplore.saveHint: 儲存後，今日穿搭、身材穿搭報告和穿搭助手都會按這個方向給建議，隨時可以重新測試。
styleExplore.askPrompt: 我的風格測試結果是「{style}」。我是穿搭新手，該怎麼入門？先買哪幾件？
